beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: Milan joins inherited house authority to contemporary systems of staging, craft, platform distribution, wholesale and traceability. This chapter follows memory: The venue disappears, schedules change and links decay; preservation choices determine which technical history remains citable and contestable.
beats.onScreen: Then: Italy’s public archive and museum surfaces, Modateca Deanna and Politecnico di Milano preserve different slices of fashion knowledge: records, objects, textiles and research.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: Italy’s public archive and museum surfaces, Modateca Deanna and Politecnico di Milano preserve different slices of fashion knowledge: records, objects, textiles and research. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: CNMI’s live gallery and video surfaces preserve selected official images and moving-image records, but discovery does not equal permission to reproduce.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: No complete public, rights-cleared archive of every Milan show, worker, venue, invitation, technical credit and commercial outcome was located.
